entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. Let's get this done quickly.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your account, could I get your order number?
It's VF778-9102. The band is not working.
Thank you. I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. Just to be clear, when you say it's not working, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's broken. It won't sync to the app, no matter what I do. I've wasted enough time on it. The thing is clearly defective and I want my money back.
I understand your frustration. I'm very sorry to hear the band isn't performing as it should. Let me just take a quick look at our return policy for you. One moment.
Okay, I've got it pulled up. I see here that you received the item 19 days ago. According to our policy, you have 90 days from the delivery date for a return.
Good. So you're processing the return?

Yes, absolutely. You are well within the timeframe. I've just approved the return in our system. I'm sending the prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. You should receive it in the next few minutes.
Okay, that's what I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the defective band back at our warehouse, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
